title: Aaye Qateel-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
body:
AAYE QATIL-E-KARBALA – YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN
AAYE GHAREEB-E-NAINAWA – YA HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Hussain Ibne Ali Assalam Assalam
Sibte Paighambar Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Dilbar-e-Hyder Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
1.Roze Aanshoor Luta Asr Talak Ghar Tera
Koi Bakhi Na Raha Tujhku Bachane Wala
Haaye Pamal Howa Dasht Me Tera Laasha
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Haq Pe Qurban Howe Aun-o-Mohd Run Me
Chur Zakhmou Se Karbobala Ke Bun Me
Kaisi Yeh Aag Laagi Shah Tere Gulshan Me
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qateel-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Haaye Aathara Baras Maa Ne Jisse Tha Pala
Khake Seene Pe Seena Khoon Ka Dariya Ubla
Haal par Tere Taras Koi Na Khaya Moula
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Haaye Masoom Gala Teer-e-Sitam Waiwala
Usku Ek Boond Bhi Paani Ka Na Ummat Ne Diye
Uska Dum Todhna Hathou Pe Jo Tumne Dekha
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Pouhche Jab Laash Pe Qasim Ki Tha Khoon Ka Manzar
Run Me Pamal Tha Bikhra Howa Farwa Ka Pisar
Tukhde Qasim Ke Uthana Wo Tera Roro Kar
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Bafawa Sher-e-jaari Pouhcha Jo Paani Ke LIye
Laota Jis Waqt Laaga Gurz-e-Sitam Baazu Kaate
Haan Palatna Wo Tera Mashk-o-Alam Saath Liye
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Aayi Hai Teri Behan Laut Ke Chehlum Ke Liye
Mere Maajaye Wafa Karke Main Aayi Wade
Saath Soughat-e-Safar Neel Hai Baazu Pa Mera
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Jayungi Maa Ki Halat Par Tera Kurta Lekar
Maa Ki Turbat Se Kahungi Hai Saughat-e-Safar
Dastan Saari Sonaungi Wahi Roro Kar
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Sheh Ka Khat Padhke Habeeb Ibne Mazahir Jo Chale
Ek Ek Lafz Pe Wo Aansu Bahate Hi Rahe
Aise Ansar Khudawand Ne Tumku Bakhse
<<MINI>>
Aaye Qatil-e-Karbala Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aaye Ghareeb-e-Nainawa Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
